question: Will the 12-month change in the U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI-U, all items, seasonally adjusted; computed from the index) for February 2024 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2024-02-14) be above 3.32%, its value for December 2023?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2024-01-15 (December 2023), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
